analysis.key_insight: The system's fundamental weakness is missing authoritative technical and legal documents in vector stores, resulting in poor source citation scores (2.42-2.65/5) despite decent factual accuracy (3.31-3.88/5). This indicates the LLM has knowledge but cannot cite proper sources, which is critical for expert-level responses in professional domains.

next_action: Execute the ingestion workflow for DTU norms and Eurocodes documents into the BTP vector store, as this addresses the most critical data gap affecting the sector with the lowest performance (20% pass rate, 33/100 avg score).
